propositions: The reconciler's committed .bridge_state cache accounts for 92% of the 1.04 GiB tickets branch size due to high churn in bookkeeping fields (baseline_advanced_at and last_get_pass) that are not read by the application, causing poor git delta compression and ~12.79 KB marginal cost per version.

Deleting the baseline_advanced_at timestamp and moving last_get_pass to a separate get_rotation.json file will reduce marginal packed cost to ~1.74 KB per version (7.4x improvement) and halve version count growth by eliminating write-on-every-pass bookkeeping.

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import will reclaim ~1 GiB of existing repository size (reducing 1.17 GB to 99 MB) while preserving all commits, merges, and producing byte-identical HEAD tree.

The rewrite requires explicit operational quiescence (disabled workflows, no active sessions, stopped MCP servers) and writer epoch guards at sync._union_merge and push.py to fail-closed on stale clones and enable safe rollback.

Rollout gates must include descendant workflow execution evidence, explicit host binary refresh, mixed-version self-healing validation, and post-rewrite ancestry/size verification before and after the first real writer deployment.

Text normalization of baseline description/status/priority (excluding assignee) combined with narrowing prev_snapshot.json to key-set will eliminate ineffective corpus mutations while maintaining zero delta in Jira payload effects.
